fields.name: aws_auth
fields.description: Enable AWS Sigv4 Authentication for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: aws_external_id
fields.description: External ID for the AWS IAM Role specified with aws_role_arn.

fields.name: aws_profile
fields.description: AWS profile name.

fields.name: aws_region
fields.description: Specify the AWS region for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: aws_role_arn
fields.description: AWS IAM Role to assume to put records to your Amazon cluster.

fields.name: aws_service_name
fields.description: Service name to use in AWS Sigv4 signature. For integration with Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, set to aoss. See Amazon OpenSearch Serverless for more information.

fields.name: aws_sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify the custom STS endpoint to be used with STS API for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: buffer_size
fields.description: Specify the buffer size used to read the response from the Elasticsearch HTTP service. Use for debugging purposes where required to read full responses. Response size grows depending of the number of records inserted. To use an unlimited amount of memory, set this value to False. Otherwise set the value according to the Unit Size.

fields.name: cloud_auth
fields.description: Specify the credentials to use to connect to Elastic's Elasticsearch Service running on Elastic Cloud.

fields.name: cloud_id
fields.description: If using Elastic's Elasticsearch Service you can specify the cloud_id of the cluster running. The string has the format <deployment_name>:<base64_info>. Once decoded, the base64_info string has the format <deployment_region>$<elasticsearch_hostname>$<kibana_hostname>.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism. Option available is gzip.

fields.name: current_time_index
fields.description: Use current time for index generation instead of message record.

fields.name: generate_id
fields.description: When enabled, generate _id for outgoing records. This prevents duplicate records when retrying ES.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target Elasticsearch instance.

fields.name: http_api_key
fields.description: API key for authenticating with Elasticsearch. Must be base64 encoded. If http_user or cloud_auth are defined, this parameter is ignored.

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Password for user defined in http_user.

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Optional username credential for Elastic X-Pack access.

fields.name: id_key
fields.description: If set, _id will be the value of the key from the incoming record and generate_id option is ignored.

fields.name: include_tag_key
fields.description: When enabled, appends the Tag name to the record.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Index name.

fields.name: logstash_dateformat
fields.description: Time format based on strftime to generate the second part of the Index name.

fields.name: logstash_format
fields.description: Enable Logstash format compatibility. This option takes a Boolean value: True/False, On/Off.

fields.name: logstash_prefix
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, the Index name is composed using a prefix and the date. For example, if logstash_prefix is equal to mydata your index will become mydata-YYYY.MM.DD. The last string appended belongs to the date when the data is being generated.

fields.name: logstash_prefix_key
fields.description: When included, the value of the key in the record is evaluated as a key reference and overrides logstash_prefix for index generation. If the key/value isn't found in the record then the logstash_prefix option acts as a fallback. The parameter is expected to be a record accessor.

fields.name: logstash_prefix_separator
fields.description: Set a separator between logstash_prefix and date.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Elasticsearch accepts new data on HTTP query path /_bulk. You can also serve Elasticsearch behind a reverse proxy on a sub-path. Define the path by adding a path prefix in the indexing HTTP POST URI.

fields.name: pipeline
fields.description: Define which pipeline the database should use. For performance reasons, it's strongly suggested to do parsing and filtering on Fluent Bit side, and avoid pipelines.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target Elasticsearch instance.

fields.name: replace_dots
fields.description: When enabled, replace field name dots with underscore. Required by Elasticsearch 2.0-2.3.

fields.name: suppress_type_name
fields.description: When enabled, mapping types is removed and type option is ignored. Elasticsearch 8.0.0 or higher no longer supports mapping types.

fields.name: tag_key
fields.description: When include_tag_key is enabled, this property defines the key name for the tag.

fields.name: time_key
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, each record will get a new timestamp field. The time_key property defines the name of that field.

fields.name: time_key_format
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, this property defines the format of the timestamp.

fields.name: time_key_nanos
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, enabling this property sends nanosecond precision timestamps.

fields.name: trace_error
fields.description: If Elasticsearch returns an error, print the Elasticsearch API request and response for diagnostics.

fields.name: trace_output
fields.description: Print all Elasticsearch API request payloads to stdout for diagnostics.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type name.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: write_operation
fields.description: Operation type for records. Can be any of: create, index, update, upsert.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
